## Validation / 验证

<!-- List the checks you ran and their results. / 请列出执行的检查及结果。 -->

- [ ] I ran the checks relevant to this change, or explained why a check was not applicable. / 我已运行与本次改动相关的检查，或说明了不适用的原因。
- [ ] Behavior changes include appropriate tests. / 行为变化已补充适当测试。
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes. / `git diff --check` 已通过。

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] This PR contains only related changes. / 本 PR 只包含相关改动。
- [ ] User-visible behavior changes are reflected in both Chinese and English documentation when needed. / 用户可见行为变化已按需同步到中英文文档。
- [ ] Public content contains no credentials, private repository URLs, personal information, complete local paths, internal systems, or private business data. / 公开内容不包含凭据、私有仓库地址、个人信息、完整本机路径、内部系统或私有业务数据。
- [ ] Public documentation describes user-facing capabilities and avoids unnecessary key implementation details. / 公开文档只描述用户可见能力，不包含不必要的关键技术实现细节。
- [ ] No local-only files, build outputs, or unrelated generated files are included. / 未包含仅限本地的文件、构建产物或无关生成文件。
